# server commands

Every `server` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `server:reload`

Gracefully reload Swoole workers (fast, code-only, no env refresh)

```bash
bin/semitexa server:reload
```

## `server:restart`

Restart Semitexa Environment (full restart with autoload rebuild and env refresh)

```bash
bin/semitexa server:restart
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--service` | yes |

## `server:start`

Start Semitexa Environment (Docker Compose)

```bash
bin/semitexa server:start
```

## `server:stop`

Stop Semitexa Environment

```bash
bin/semitexa server:stop
```
